question.text: In the Sunita Gupta case (Case 8.3), what was the penalty imposed by the Adjudicating Officer on remand?

explanation.text: The Logic: On remand by SAT, the fresh AO reduced the penalty from the original Rs. 60 lakhs to Rs. 25 lakhs after considering all mitigating circumstances. The Trap: Rs. 60 lakhs was the original penalty imposed before remand. The question specifically asks about the penalty on remand. Cross-Exam Context: Understanding penalty variations across different stages of adjudication is important for NISM Series III-A. Exam Tip: Penalties can be modified on appeal/remand - always note the FINAL penalty amount in case studies.
